evals.prompt: Map this page for me so I can write Playwright tests against it: https://www.wikipedia.org
evals.expected_output: A saved page-map__wikipedia-org__home.json file in ./page-maps/ containing areas (e.g. header_area, search_area), elements with selectors, bounds, and aliases. Followed by a summary of total elements and areas mapped.

evals.prompt: I need a DOM reference map for https://github.com/login — I want to use it later with Playwright to automate the login flow.
evals.expected_output: A saved page-map__github-com__login.json with form fields (username, password, submit button) mapped as elements, a login_form_area grouping them, page-absolute bounds for each, and high-confidence selectors where possible.

evals.prompt: Generate element selectors for this page: https://www.bbc.com/news — I want to map the navigation, article cards, and footer.
evals.expected_output: A saved page-map__bbc-com__news.json with navigation elements, article card elements grouped into a card area, footer elements grouped into a footer_area, page-absolute bounds, and plain-English aliases for each.
